our_takes.our-take: The WorldFirst Corporate Card is a business debit card built for companies with international spending needs. Its strongest value comes from fee-free foreign card payments when you hold the same currency, combined with multi-currency balances and spend controls. This makes it practical for paying overseas suppliers, subscriptions, and travel costs while avoiding typical FX card surcharges. However, it offers no credit float, and any rewards (such as cashback) are programme-dependent, so its appeal is primarily cost efficiency and control, not financing.
our_takes.good-for:
Businesses paying overseas vendors or FCY subscriptions
Teams that want tight spend control without interest
Online-first companies using card-not-present payments
SMEs managing employee expenses with limits and controls
our_takes.things-to-note:
This is a 
debit card
—payments draw from available balances only
“No FX fee” works best when you hold the same currency; conversions still apply otherwise
Cashback (if any) is offer-dependent, not guaranteed
Restricted categories may trigger transaction declines
ATM access is limited; designed mainly for cashless spend
